check:
  kind: regex
  prompt: Paste a trace id (32 hexadecimal characters).
  pattern: "[0-9a-f]{32}"
---

<Why>
Some answers differ between two healthy labs, such as a trace id. A pattern check accepts any value of the right shape, so the learner proves they found one without the site knowing which.
</Why>

<Idea>
The whole pasted text must match the pattern.
</Idea>

<Do>
1. Find any trace id and paste it below.
</Do>

<Done>
The check says passed.
</Done>

<Question id="q-m90-s03" answer="c">
When is a regex check the right choice?

- When every lab gives the same answer

  Then an exact check is stricter.

- When the answer is a number in a range

  Then a range check fits.

- When the answer differs between labs but has a fixed shape

  Right: the pattern checks the shape.

- When the learner picks from options

  Then a choice check fits.
</Question>
